speaker: EN_A
text:
Welcome to KC desk note. Today we
are unpacking one fresh research
report and the question it raises.

speaker: EN_A
text:
NetEase just reported its
first-quarter results for fiscal
2026, and the numbers came in well
above expectations.

speaker: EN_B
text:
That’s right. Revenue grew 6% year
on year to over 30 billion yuan,
beating consensus by 4%.

speaker: EN_A
text:
And what really drove that beat?
Was it a new game launch or
something else?

speaker: EN_B
text:
Actually, it was the old reliable
titles. PC games like the Fantasy
Westward Journey series and Where
Winds Meet showed impressive

speaker: EN_B
text: resilience.

speaker: EN_A
text:
So the existing portfolio is still
performing strongly, even against
a high base from last year.

speaker: EN_B
text:
Exactly. The PC version of Fantasy
Westward Journey even hit a record
high for peak concurrent users, at
3.9 million.

speaker: EN_A
text:
That’s a strong signal for the
core business. But I also noticed
the margin story was quite
compelling.

speaker: EN_B
text:
Yes, gross margin expanded by over
5 percentage points to 69.4%. The
gaming segment alone hit a record
high of 74.8%.

speaker: EN_A
text:
That’s a huge jump. What explains
such a big improvement?

speaker: EN_B
text:
It’s mostly a mix shift.
Higher-margin PC titles took a
larger share of revenue,

speaker: EN_B
text:
and the company also benefited
from lower revenue-sharing fees
charged by app stores.

speaker: EN_A
text:
So the profitability story is not
just about revenue growth, but
about how they’re making more from
each dollar of sales.

speaker: EN_B
text:
Precisely. Non-GAAP operating
profit rose 17% year on year, and
the operating margin expanded to
over 43%.

speaker: EN_A
text:
Now, the report also mentions an
upcoming title called Sea of
Remnants. What’s the significance
there?

speaker: EN_B
text:
That’s a key catalyst for the
second half of the year. It’s
slated for a third-quarter launch,
possibly as early as July to catch

speaker: EN_B
text: the summer gaming season.

speaker: EN_A
text:
So the market is looking at that
as a potential re-acceleration
point for gaming growth.

speaker: EN_B
text:
That’s the general expectation.
But the report doesn’t settle the
question of how big that title
will actually be.

speaker: EN_A
text:
That’s a fair point. There’s
always uncertainty around new game
performance.

speaker: EN_B
text:
And there’s another open question.
The company didn’t update on
converting its Hong Kong shares to
a primary listing.

speaker: EN_A
text:
That could be a meaningful
corporate event down the line.

speaker: EN_B
text:
It is. But for now, the focus
remains on the strong operational
execution and the pipeline.

speaker: EN_A
text:
So for listeners who want the full
picture, the report goes deeper
into the numbers and the valuation
framework.

speaker: EN_B
text:
Absolutely. There’s a lot more
detail on segment performance and
the sum-of-the-parts valuation.

speaker: EN_A
text:
And we’ll leave it there for now.
Thanks for breaking that down.

speaker: EN_B
text:
My pleasure. Happy to continue the
discussion in the community if
anyone wants to dive deeper.
